dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_main_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes essential packages for gRPC development (google-api-python-client for Google services, typeguard for type checking, grpc-interceptor for gRPC middleware, and greenlet for coroutine support). The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim for a lightweight environment, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets up the application to run your main script.
